cms-extension — The VS Code extension — front matter as controls, a dashboard, SEO insights and a governed publishing path.
  path:       .  (owns src/**, media/**, schemas/**, package.json, package-lock.json, esbuild.js, eslint.config.mjs, tsconfig.json, test-runner.js, .vscode-test.mjs, .vscodeignore, .vsix-manifest.txt)
  kind:       extension   stack: node
  upstream:   bamr87/zer0-CMS
  depends on: -
  used by:    -
  publishes:  vsix
  ci:         extension.yml
  setup       npm ci
  check       npm run compile
  test        npm test
  build       npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies

content — The platform — Django + Wagtail pages, the agent harness and its one tool registry, suggestions, the content graph, the outbox, GraphQL/REST/MCP over all of it, and the ops baseline (ADR 0001, ADR 0004).
  path:       content  (owns content/**, schemas/events/**, schemas/graphql/**, schemas/content/**, schemas/openapi/**)
  kind:       app   stack: python, docker
  upstream:   bamr87/zer0-CMS
  depends on: -
  used by:    -
  publishes:  -
  ci:         content.yml
  setup       pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
  check       python3 -m pytest -q -m "not slow" && python3 manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
  test        python3 -m pytest -q && python3 manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run && ruff check . && ruff format --check .
  build       docker build -f Dockerfile ..

cms-rails — The fleet CMS — a Rails 8.1 app that indexes every registered site and writes edits back to the files, plus the stdlib-only zer0 library (catalog, doctor, ABC generator).
  path:       rails
  kind:       rails   stack: ruby
  upstream:   bamr87/zer0-CMS
  depends on: zer0-image-generator
  used by:    -
  publishes:  -
  ci:         rails-app.yml
  setup       bundle install
  check       bash bin/test-stdlib
  test        bin/rails test && bin/rails zeitwerk:check

zer0-image-generator — AI preview and social-image generation for any Jekyll site — the jekyll preview-images gem, its Python engine, the byte-identical Ruby port and the web panel.
  path:       packages/zer0-image-generator
  kind:       gem   stack: ruby, python
  upstream:   bamr87/zer0-image-generator
  depends on: -
  used by:    cms-rails, zer0-pages
  publishes:  gem:zer0-image-generator
  ci:         zer0-image-generator.yml
  setup       python3 -m pip install pyyaml
  check       for f in test/ruby/test_*.rb; do ruby -Ilib "$f" || exit 1; done [LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8]
  test        python3 test/test_preview_generator.py && ruby test/test_command.rb && for f in test/ruby/test_*.rb; do ruby -Ilib "$f" || exit 1; done [LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8]
  build       gem build zer0-image-generator.gemspec

books — A shelf of book projects (library/<slug>/) and the bookshelf app that validates, compiles and edits them, with a Claude-backed studio.
  path:       packages/books
  kind:       python   stack: python
  upstream:   bamr87/books
  depends on: -
  used by:    -
  publishes:  -
  ci:         books.yml
  setup       pip install -e ".[dev]"
  check       python3 -m pytest -q [PYTHONPATH=src]
  test        python3 -m pytest -q && ruff check src tests

1987 — The self-growing knowledge base about the year 1987 — plain-markdown topic pages by category, grown by Claude Code slash commands and published by GitHub Pages from the original repository.
  path:       sites/1987
  kind:       site   stack: python
  upstream:   bamr87/1987
  depends on: -
  used by:    -
  publishes:  pages
